source.original_text: Assume the six displayed analytic hypotheses. Put V_y(x)=V(x)+||x-y||^2/(2 eta), pi_y=volume.tilted(-V_y), gamma=stdGaussian(E), nu_y=pi_y times gamma and P=Exp(1)^N. Use the literal fixed-reference PBPS flow with center c=y-eta grad V(r), position c+cos(t)(x-c)+sqrt(eta)sin(t)p and momentum -sin(t)(x-c)/sqrt(eta)+cos(t)p. The bounce reflects momentum in grad V(x)-grad V(r), with the identity for a zero normal; its rate is sqrt(eta) max(0,<p,grad V(x)-grad V(r)>). Independent exponential thresholds determine integrated-hazard waiting times, post-bounce records and between-jump interpolation. The existing raw initial-state fallback outside covered intervals is retained, not introduced anew. There is one global jointly measurable actual process Z with the every-raw-input arc/fallback rules and parameterwise clock-AE zero-time initialization. Its endpoint sends nu_y times P to nu_y; bounded signed flip duality and jointly measurable bounded-Borel clock expectations retain their integrability and uniform bounds. A single joint-index probability kernel Kphase has every fiber exactly map(Z(y,r,z,t))P. For every fixed y,r,t the state-kernel z -> Kphase(((y,r),z),t) preserves nu_y as an exact measure equality. For each y,r the SAME continuous real-linear L2(nu_y) family A_t satisfies A_0=I, ||A_t||<=1 and A_t f -> f at zero for every f. Every canonical L2 representative f-sharp is integrable on almost every kernel fiber, and (A_t f)-sharp(z)=integral f-sharp(z') Kphase(((y,r),z),t)(dz') for nu_y-almost every z. A_t preserves AE nonnegativity and fixes every real constant class, whose L2 membership is produced. All earlier arbitrary-MemLp clock representation and square-integral bounds remain. The momentum flip J is an involutive isometry and A_t*=J A_t J. The position pullback B is isometric; M=B* equals Gaussian integration for arbitrary MemLp representatives, MB=I, JB=B, MJ=M. Kpos_t=M A_t B remains a self-adjoint contraction with Kpos_0=I and its Gaussian-outer/clock-inner representative, including both nested AE integrability obligations. This identifies a phase probability kernel and its existing operator, not a restart law or a position probability kernel.

decoder_context: Finite-dimensional real inner-product Borel space with canonical volume, including rank zero; genuine second Frechet derivative and real Hilbert gradient.
Fin n is zero-based; Fin.cons prepends; Fin.induction constructs a finite sequence; Fin.foldl visits ascending indices. Sum.inl represents a live time/state record; Unit represents a stopped record.

Real division by zero is zero; Real.toNNReal is positive part; nonnegative subtraction is truncated. ENNReal.ofReal embeds the positive part in extended nonnegative reals. Interval integrals use real Lebesgue measure.

Measure.tilted mu h is mu.withDensity(x -> ofReal(exp(h(x))/integral exp(h) dmu)). stdGaussian E is the centered identity-covariance Gaussian. Measure.comap along a measurable subtype inclusion is the induced subtype measure. Products use the displayed coordinate order.

MeasurePreserving f mu nu states Measurable f and Measure.map f mu = nu. withDensity multiplies the base measure by the given extended-nonnegative density. Measure.sum is the countable sum of the displayed measures. IsProbabilityMeasure means total mass one. All literal let bindings are definitions, not hypotheses.

hittingAfter f D 0 a is the infimum of nonnegative times t at which f t a lies in D, in WithTop nonnegative reals; the empty infimum is top. untopD 0 returns the finite value when not top and zero otherwise.

Measure.infinitePi constructs the displayed countable product law; expMeasure 1 is the unit-rate exponential probability measure on real numbers. The function space carries the coordinate-product measurable structure. A measurable global process and its almost-everywhere initialization are conclusions.

Lp R 2 mu is the real Hilbert space of square-integrable strongly measurable functions modulo almost-everywhere equality; MemLp is the corresponding property of a raw function and hG.toLp G is its equivalence class.
The notation X ->L[R] Y means a continuous real linear map with operator norm. ContinuousLinearMap.id is the identity; an indexed family of such maps alone imposes no continuity in the index.

The notation X ->li[R] Y denotes a real linear norm-preserving map. Lp.compMeasurePreserving_li R hR is the canonical pullback on Lp classes by a measure-preserving map R. The adjoint A.adjoint is the real Hilbert adjoint characterized by <A* f,g>=<f,A g>; comp composes continuous linear maps.
Kernel A B is a measurable map from indices A to measures on B. IsMarkovKernel means every fiber has total mass one. K.comap i hi precomposes its index by the measurable map i.

Kernel.Invariant k mu means mu.bind k = mu. A probability-fiber kernel alone imposes no temporal Markov/restart/semigroup law. Coercing an Lp class chooses a globally strongly measurable representative, unique only almost everywhere.

The expression f>=0 almost everywhere is scalar pointwise nonnegativity of a chosen representative off a null set; preservation of it is not Loewner positivity of a Hilbert operator. All AE assertions have exactly the displayed parameter scope.

Let E be an arbitrary finite-dimensional real inner-product space, equipped with its Borel measurable structure and canonical volume; dimension zero is allowed. Let V:E→ℝ, α,β∈ℝ≥0 and η∈ℝ. There are exactly six displayed hypothesis binders:
(hα) 0<α as a real number;
(hαβ) α≤β;
(hV) V is C² over ℝ;
(hH) for every x,v∈E, α‖v‖²≤(D(DV)(x)[v])[v]≤β‖v‖², where these are the actual Fréchet derivatives of V;
(hη) 0<η;
(hβη) βη≤1.
All conclusions below hold under these hypotheses.

Definitions used in the conclusions. Write Q=E×E, Ω=ℕ→ℝ, and ℝ≥0 for nonnegative real time. For y,xRef∈E put c=y−η∇V(xRef). For real t and z=(x,p)∈Q define
Φ(y,xRef,t,(x,p))=(c+cos(t)(x−c)+√η sin(t)p, −sin(t)(x−c)/√η+cos(t)p).

the same real-L2 family, with AE positivity and every constant class fixed.
This does not prove process Markovness, restart or Chapman--Kolmogorov. -/

    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]

    (hα : 0 < (α : ℝ)) (hαβ : α ≤ β) (hV : ContDiff ℝ 2 V)
    (hH : ∀ x v : E,
      (α : ℝ) * ‖v‖ ^ 2 ≤ (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x v) v ∧
      (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x v) v ≤ (β : ℝ) * ‖v‖ ^ 2)
    (hη : 0 < η) (hβη : (β : ℝ) * η ≤ 1) : actual_kernel_l2_realization_statement hα hαβ hV hH hη hβη := by
  classical
  unfold actual_kernel_l2_realization_statement
  intro c Φ S rate Λ τ next record P ε history Rec Hist readTime Δ Prefix m zAt K qReal q A eventTime I N liveTime d survival weight C Path Ψ Γ ρ R Vy nu
  obtain ⟨Z, hZm, hZa, hZf, hZ0, h106, hBorel, h110⟩ :=
    AutoSamplingTheory.ExampleCases.ProximalBPS.ActualL2StrongContinuity.actual_l2_strong_continuity
      hα hαβ hV hH hη hβη
  obtain ⟨Zk, _hZkm, hZka, hZkf, _hZkgood,
      Kphase, hK, hfiber, _hset, _hinit, _hbounded⟩ :=
    AutoSamplingTheory.ExampleCases.ProximalBPS.ActualPhaseTransitionKernel.actual_phase_transition_kernel
      hα hαβ hV hH hη hβη
  -- Same literal recursion and raw fallback identify the two path witnesses.
  have hZeq : Zk = Z := by
    funext y xRef z t w
    by_cases hx : ∃ n, w ∈ I y xRef z t n
    · obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hx
      obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ : ∃ a, record y xRef z (ε w) n = Sum.inl a := by
        cases hr : record y xRef z (ε w) n with
        | inl a => exact ⟨a, rfl⟩
        | inr u =>
          have hh := hn.1
          change (record y xRef z (ε w) n).elim
            (fun a => (a.1 : WithTop ℝ≥0)) (fun _ => ⊤) ≤ (t : WithTop ℝ≥0) at hh
          rw [hr] at hh
          exact False.elim ((WithTop.not_top_le_coe t) hh)
      exact (hZka y xRef z w t n a hn.1 hn.2 ha).trans
        (hZa y xRef z w t n a hn ha).symm
    · exact (hZkf y xRef z w t hx).trans (hZf y xRef z w t hx).symm
  rw [hZeq] at hfiber
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure P :=
    AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.Probability.UnitExponentialProduct.unit_exponential_product_laws.1
  letI : IsMarkovKernel Kphase := hK
  have hzM (y xRef : E) (z : E × E) (T : ℝ≥0) :
      Measurable (Z y xRef z T) := hZm.comp
    (show Measurable (fun w : ℕ → ℝ => (((y, xRef), z), T, w)) from
      measurable_const.prodMk (measurable_const.prodMk measurable_id))
  -- A fixed-time endpoint pushforward, not a restart/Markov argument.
  have hInv (y xRef : E) (T : ℝ≥0) :
      (Kphase.comap (fun z : E × E => (((y, xRef), z), T))
        (by fun_prop)).Invariant (nu y) := by
    let κ : Kernel (E × E) (E × E) :=
      Kphase.comap (fun z : E × E => (((y, xRef), z), T)) (by fun_prop)
    have he := (h106 y xRef T).1
    change (nu y).bind κ = nu y
    calc
      (nu y).bind κ =
          Measure.map (fun a : (E × E) × (ℕ → ℝ) => Z y xRef a.1 T a.2)
            ((nu y).prod P) := by
        ext s hs
        rw [Measure.bind_apply hs κ.aemeasurable, Measure.map_apply he.measurable hs,
          Measure.prod_apply (he.measurable hs)]
        apply lintegral_congr_ae
        filter_upwards with z
        change Kphase (((y, xRef), z), T) s =

        rw [hfiber, Measure.map_apply (hzM y xRef z T) hs]

    rw [hnorm.2.2.2.2.2.2] at hp
    exact hp
  have hreal (T : ℝ≥0) (f : Lp ℝ 2 (nu y)) :
      (∀ᵐ z ∂nu y, Integrable (f : (E × E) → ℝ)
        (Kphase (((y, xRef), z), T))) ∧
      (L T f : (E × E) → ℝ) =ᵐ[nu y]
        fun z => ∫ z', f z' ∂Kphase (((y, xRef), z), T) := by
    let opG : (E × E) → ℝ := fun z => ∫ w, f (Z y xRef z T w) ∂P
    have hclock := (hL T).2 (f : (E × E) → ℝ) (Lp.memLp f)
    obtain ⟨hOp, heq⟩ := hclock.2.1
    have heq' : L T f = hOp.toLp opG := by
      simpa only [Lp.toLp_coeFn] using heq
    have hae : (L T f : (E × E) → ℝ) =ᵐ[nu y] opG := by
      rw [heq']
      exact hOp.coeFn_toLp
    have hinter (z : E × E) :
        (∫ z', f z' ∂Kphase (((y, xRef), z), T)) = opG z := by

    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · filter_upwards [hclock.1] with z hz
      rw [hfiber]
      exact (integrable_map_measure
        (Lp.stronglyMeasurable f).aestronglyMeasurable (hzM y xRef z T).aemeasurable).2 hz
    · filter_upwards [hae] with z hz
      exact hz.trans (hinter z).symm
  refine ⟨L, hL0, hSC, hreal, ?_, ?_, hL, hRest⟩
  · intro T f hf
    let κ : Kernel (E × E) (E × E) :=
      Kphase.comap (fun z : E × E => (((y, xRef), z), T)) (by fun_prop)
    have hcomp : ∀ᵐ z ∂((nu y).bind κ), 0 ≤ f z := by
      rw [(hInv y xRef T).def]
      exact hf
    have hfib := Measure.ae_ae_of_ae_comp (κ := κ) hcomp
    filter_upwards [(hreal T f).2, hfib] with z hz hzz
    rw [hz]
    exact integral_nonneg_of_ae hzz
  · intro T r
    have hr : MemLp (fun _ : E × E => r) 2 (nu y) := memLp_const r
    let f : Lp ℝ 2 (nu y) := hr.toLp (fun _ : E × E => r)
    let κ : Kernel (E × E) (E × E) :=
      Kphase.comap (fun z : E × E => (((y, xRef), z), T)) (by fun_prop)
    have hcae : (f : (E × E) → ℝ) =ᵐ[nu y] fun _ => r := hr.coeFn_toLp
    have hcomp : ∀ᵐ z ∂((nu y).bind κ), f z = r := by
      rw [(hInv y xRef T).def]
      exact hcae
    have hfib := Measure.ae_ae_of_ae_comp (κ := κ) hcomp
    refine ⟨hr, ?_⟩
    change L T f = f
    apply Lp.ext
    filter_upwards [(hreal T f).2, hcae, hfib] with z hz hzr hfz
    calc
      L T f z = ∫ z', f z' ∂Kphase (((y, xRef), z), T) := hz
      _ = ∫ _ : E × E, r ∂Kphase (((y, xRef), z), T) := integral_congr_ae hfz
      _ = r := by simp
      _ = f z := hzr.symm

end

Kpos_t=M A_t B remains a self-adjoint contraction with Kpos_0=I and its Gaussian-outer/clock-inner representative, including both nested AE integrability obligations. This identifies a phase probability kernel and its existing operator, not a restart law or a position probability kernel.
